Cylinder_vs_Triangle.mathematicalModel: Exact 3D segment-to-triangle distance minus radius: min_{s in Segment, t in Triangle} ||s - t|| - R
Cylinder_vs_Triangle.requiredAlgorithm: Analytical closest points between finite 3D line segment and 3D triangle (interior face, 3 edges, 3 vertices).
Cylinder_vs_Triangle.contactNormal: Unit vector along segment-triangle shortest distance vector

Capsule_vs_Capsule.mathematicalModel: Segment-to-segment shortest distance minus sum of radii: ||pA - pB|| - (R1 + R2)
Capsule_vs_Capsule.requiredAlgorithm: Lumelsky / Ericson segment-segment analytical closest point solver with parallel segment degeneracy handling.

Triangle_vs_Triangle.mathematicalModel: Moller / Guigue-Devillers exact 3D triangle-triangle intersection test.
Triangle_vs_Triangle.requiredAlgorithm: Plane equation scalar triple products followed by 2D interval overlap.

BRep_vs_BRep.requiredAlgorithm: Exact topological boolean intersection computing intersecting solid/face and volume/centroid.

ConvexHull_vs_ConvexHull.mathematicalModel: Gilbert-Johnson-Keerthi (GJK) distance solver + Expanding Polytope Algorithm (EPA) for penetration depth.
ConvexHull_vs_ConvexHull.requiredAlgorithm: Support mapping on Minkowski difference CSO.
